sentences.en: There was a flag at the top of the pole.
A red and white flag was flying in the wind.
sentences.zh: 一面红白相间的旗帜在风中飘扬。

sentences.en: We waved flags to welcome members of our baseball team.
sentences.zh: 我们挥动旗帜欢迎棒球队的成员。
